tasks.design: Configure native chronology and evidence-reference views in {CASE_SYSTEM}, denoted OTHER. The detective verifies actual records and personally determines investigation scope, timing and direction. Final plan writing, approval, commit and internal delivery stay separate; no predictive policing or automated investigative decision is introduced.

tasks.enabler_now: Native case chronology views can preserve exact event dates and source references.

assumptions: All shares are provisional. Verify residual manual event alignment after existing case tools; existing timelines and runtime earn no saving.
